subject: Life Skills

source.subtopic: Birds: different birds; feathers, two legs, a beak, lay eggs; birds that cannot fly (ostrich, penguin); nests

show.line: Birds have feathers, two legs and a beak. Most birds can fly, and all birds lay eggs.

rounds.prompt: Where does a bird lay its eggs?
Can it fly? Sort the birds.
How many legs does a bird have?

hints: Look for feathers and a beak.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! A penguin is a bird.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: So a penguin can fly high in the sky!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! A penguin cannot fly. It swims.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Penguins are birds, but they swim. They cannot fly!

parent_line: Can name things all birds have and birds that cannot fly.
